Wellness Insights: Corporate Wellness Programs in India by ASK Insights

ASK Insights designs corporate wellness programs in India for organizations seeking a structured, year-long plan rather than a once-a-year health check-up. The Wellness Insights capsule brings together senior psychologists, medical specialists, and certified coaches into a single program, shaped around what your workforce actually needs.

Discuss Your Organization’s Wellbeing Priorities

What Is Wellness Insights?

Wellness Insights is ASK Insights’ corporate wellness program for organizations in India and abroad. It runs as a one-year capsule, not a string of one-off events, and it is built for CHROs, People and Culture leaders, and business leaders who need psychological support, physical wellbeing, and preventive health under one program, with outcomes they can actually report to leadership.

Dr. Niru Kumar leads the program. She is a medical doctor with close to three decades of clinical experience, and she works alongside a network of senior psychologists, psychiatrists, and medical specialists. Most wellness offerings stop at a workshop calendar. Wellness Insights goes further: one-to-one counselling, corporate workshops, health camps, and wellbeing assessments, all inside a single organizational program.

Corporate Wellness Programs in India: What Does the Wellness Insights Capsule Include?

Every organization that works with ASK Insights receives a one-year Wellness Insights capsule. It is organized across five areas, and the exact mix gets agreed with your HR team based on headcount, budget, and what your people actually need.

Psychological and Mental Wellbeing Support

Up to fifteen one-to-one counselling sessions a month with senior psychologists sit at the centre of the mental health clinic. Life coaching and relationship counselling are also available, for employees who want support outside a clinical setting.

Corporate Wellbeing Workshops

Four workshops a year, chosen from themes such as stress management, emotional intelligence through neuro-linguistic programming, resilience and leadership, women’s leadership, and transformational mentoring. Each one is led by a certified facilitator, not a generalist trainer brought in for the day.

Preventive Health and Medical Specialist Access

Three health talks and two health camps a year put senior consultants directly in front of your workforce: cardiology, gynaecology, dermatology, dentistry, ophthalmology, paediatrics, and lifestyle medicine. Most of these specialists practise at BLK Super Speciality Hospital, Medanta, or Apollo on any other day of the week.

Holistic Wellbeing Sessions

Mindfulness, meditation, yoga, nutrition, and Reiki round out the offering, drawing on more than two decades of in-house experience in mindfulness and spiritual wellbeing practice.

A Whole-Person Approach: The C.A.R.E. Model

ASK Insights organizes Wellness Insights around what it calls the C.A.R.E. Model: a four-stage approach for moving an organization from a single wellbeing initiative to something sustained.

Check-in comes first: diagnostics of physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual health across the workforce. Awareness follows, building a shared understanding of what those diagnostics actually show, so leadership and employees are working from the same picture instead of guesswork. Revive is the skill-building stage, delivered through the workshops, coaching, and holistic sessions described above. Engage keeps it going: counselling, health camps, and periodic reassessment that carry the program well past the launch event and through the rest of the year.

This is why ASK Insights calls it a capsule and not a workshop series. Each stage depends on the one before it. The program is meant to run continuously, across the physical, psychological, emotional, and spiritual sides of employee wellbeing.

Wellbeing Assessments and Organizational Insights

Before recommending which workshops or specialists an organization needs most, ASK Insights runs psychometric assessments across up to five hundred employees. The goal is simple: measure current wellbeing and happiness levels instead of guessing at them.

These assessments give HR and leadership a baseline to plan against, and a way to see whether wellbeing is actually improving over the course of the capsule. That is more useful than counting attendance at workshops or reading through feedback forms. ASK Insights does not position this as a proprietary analytics platform. It is a defined benchmarking process, repeated periodically, so organizations can see where their wellbeing priorities should sit next year compared with where they started.

The Expertise Behind Wellness Insights

Dr. Niru Kumar, MBBS, is the Founder and CEO of ASK Insights and a Padma Shri recipient. She brought nearly thirty years in clinical medicine to the practice, including a term as Chief Officer in India’s Central Government Health Services, before turning her attention to organizational wellbeing. Dr. Akshay Kumar directs the psychological and coaching side of the program. He holds a PhD in Clinical and Positive Psychology and lectures at London Business School.

The wider consultant network runs deep: Dr. Prem Kumar Ganesan (Director, Radiology, BLK Super Speciality Hospital), Dr. Neeraj Bhalla (Cardiology, BLK Super Speciality Hospital), Dr. Sudipto Pakrasi (Ophthalmology, Medanta Hospital), and Dr. Lalita Bhadhwar (Gynaecology, Apollo Hospital), alongside senior specialists in paediatrics, dermatology, dentistry, and lifestyle medicine. Coaches and facilitators such as Poorvi Sarin and Danijela Radonic Bhandari hold certifications from bodies including the California Hypnosis Institute and Harvard University’s positive psychology programme.

Who Is Wellness Insights Designed For?

Wellness Insights tends to suit organizations that have outgrown the single annual health check-up and want something HR can plan a full year around. Think of companies building a structured employee wellbeing strategy from scratch, or organizations that want professional psychological support available to staff without routing every case through an external helpline. It also fits businesses that want senior medical specialists on hand directly, without a referral chain, and HR teams that need to report wellbeing outcomes to leadership with an actual baseline to measure against, not attendance counts alone.

Frequently Asked Questions

A corporate wellness program is a structured set of health, psychological, and preventive services an employer provides to support employees’ physical and mental wellbeing. Most combine counselling, medical access, and skill-building workshops instead of a single one-off event, and get planned and reviewed across a full year.
Mental health counselling, workshops on stress and resilience, preventive health check-ups or camps, and some form of wellbeing measurement. That is the common mix, though it varies by provider. ASK Insights structures its Wellness Insights capsule around five areas: counselling, workshops, preventive health, holistic sessions, and assessments.
Up to fifteen counselling sessions a month, three health talks and two health camps a year with senior medical specialists, two holistic wellbeing sessions, four corporate wellbeing workshops chosen from a set list, and psychometric assessments covering up to five hundred employees, all inside a single one-year capsule.
Through psychometric assessments that measure current wellbeing and happiness levels across an organization before ASK Insights recommends a workshop and specialist mix. The same assessment repeats periodically, so HR teams can track real movement instead of relying on attendance data alone.
Yes. Organizations pick their four corporate wellbeing workshops, two holistic sessions, and preventive health specialists from a defined list, based on team size, sector, and whatever the initial assessment turns up. The program follows what a workforce actually needs, not a fixed template.

Bring Wellness Insights to Your Organization

If your organization is mapping out next year’s employee wellbeing budget, ASK Insights can walk your HR team through exactly how the Wellness Insights capsule would work for your headcount, sector, and current priorities.
